```{r notes}
# - Collated Peeper data for SO4/Cl, H2S, Nutrients, and Fe MSM 202210, 202211, 202304, and 202306
# - Data was already processed/QAQC'd with 2022/2023 Lysimeter data
# - Missing MSM_202210_UP_PPR sulfide data
# - No 2023 nutrient peeper data
# - Iron 2023 data has not been processed and 2022 iron data was processed with an old script
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
# detach("package:raster", unload = TRUE)
```

#Read in and collate all the files in the Processed Data folder 
```{r}

##SO4/Cl

#2022
dionex_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfate_Chloride/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
dionex_2022 <- dionex_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select peeper data MSM_202210_TR_PPR_10
dionex_ppr_2022 <- dionex_2022 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "PPR")) %>% 
  rename(Zone = Replicate, Replicate = Zone, Salinity = salinity) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, "PPR", Depth, sep = "_"))
#Select only data columns
colnames(dionex_ppr_2022)
dionex_ppr_sel_2022 <- dionex_ppr_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "SO4_ppm",   "Cl_ppm",    "SO4_mM" ,   "Cl_mM"   ,  "Salinity" )

#2023
dionex_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfate_Chloride/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
dionex_2023 <- dionex_files_2023 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select peeper data MSM_202210_TR_PPR_10
dionex_ppr_2023 <- dionex_2023 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "PPR")) %>% 
  mutate(Zone = ifelse(Zone == "PPR", Replicate, Zone)) %>% 
  mutate(Replicate = "PPR") %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, "PPR", Depth, sep = "_")) %>% 
  rename(Salinity = salinity)
#Select only data columns
colnames(dionex_ppr_2023)
dionex_ppr_sel_2023 <- dionex_ppr_2023 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "SO4_ppm",   "Cl_ppm",    "SO4_mM" ,   "Cl_mM"   ,  "Salinity" )

#Combine 2022 and 2023
dionex_ppr_sel <- bind_rows(dionex_ppr_sel_2022, dionex_ppr_sel_2023)


##QAQC flagging
top_std_cl = 200   #ug/mL
top_std_so4 = 20   #ug/mL

#need to determine dilution factors
#for COMPASS this depends on the site so... 
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <- NA
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "MSM") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "UP"), 50, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "MSM") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "TR"), 100, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "MSM") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "WC"), 100, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "MSM") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "_SW_"), 100, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GCW") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "UP"), 50, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GCW") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "TR"), 50, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GCW") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "WC"), 100, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GCW") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "_SW_"), 100, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GWI") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "UP"), 100, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GWI") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "TR"), 100, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GWI") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "WC"), 200, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "GWI") & str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "_SW_"), 200, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)
dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution <-  ifelse(str_detect(dionex_ppr_sel$Sample_ID, "SWH"), 50, dionex_ppr_sel$Dilution)

flagged_dionex_data <- dionex_ppr_sel %>%
  mutate(Cl_ppm_dil = as.numeric(Cl_ppm)/Dilution, 
         SO4_ppm_dil = as.numeric(SO4_ppm)/Dilution) %>% 
  mutate(
    Cl_Conc_flag = case_when(
      Cl_ppm_dil <= 0 ~ "bdl",
      Cl_ppm_dil > top_std_cl ~ "adl", 
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>% #Flagging data if the concentration is outside the standards range and based on blanks
  mutate(
    SO4_Conc_flag = case_when(
      SO4_ppm_dil <= 0 ~ "bdl",
      SO4_ppm_dil > top_std_so4 ~ "adl", 
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  ))#Flagging data if the concentration is outside the standards range and based on blanks
  
flagged_dionex_data_sel <- flagged_dionex_data %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "SO4_ppm",   "Cl_ppm",    "SO4_mM" ,   "Cl_mM"   ,  "Salinity", "Cl_Conc_flag",  "SO4_Conc_flag")


##Sulfide
#2022
sulfide_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfide/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
sulfide_data_2022 <- sulfide_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select peeper data
sulfide_ppr_2022 <- sulfide_data_2022 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "PPR"))
#Select only data columns
colnames(sulfide_ppr_2022)
sulfide_ppr_sel_2022 <- sulfide_ppr_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "H2S_mean"     ,    "H2S_sd"        ,   "H2S_cv"          ,
"H2S_Conc_flag"  ,  "H2S_cv_flag"   ,   "H2S_QAQC_flag"  , "Run_notes",        "Field_notes") %>% 
  rename(H2S_Run_notes = Run_notes)

#2023
sulfide_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfide/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "Combined\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
# 3. Read and combine all CSVs
sulfide_data_2023 <- sulfide_files_2023 %>%

  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select peeper data
sulfide_ppr_2023 <- sulfide_data_2023 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "PPR")) %>%
  separate(Sample_ID, into = c("Site", "Date", "Replicate", "Zone", "Depth_cm"), sep = "_")  %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, "PPR", Depth_cm, sep = "_")) 
#Select only data columns
colnames(sulfide_ppr_2023)
sulfide_ppr_sel_2023 <- sulfide_ppr_2023 %>% 
  rename(H2S_mean = H2S_mean_uM, 
         H2S_sd = H2S_sd_uM) %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "H2S_mean"     ,    "H2S_sd"        ,   "H2S_cv"          ,
"H2S_Conc_flag"  ,  "H2S_cv_flag"   ,   "H2S_QAQC_flag"  , "Run_notes") %>% 
  rename(H2S_Run_notes = Run_notes)

#Combine 2022 and 2023
sulfide_ppr_sel <- bind_rows(sulfide_ppr_sel_2022, sulfide_ppr_sel_2023)


##Nutrients

#Select only data columns
colnames(nutr_ppr_2022)
nutr_ppr_sel_2022 <- nutr_ppr_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "NH3_mgL"  , "NH3_uM"  ,  "PO4_mgL" , "PO4_uM"  ,  "NOx_mgL"   ,"NOx_uM"  ,  "NH3_range", "PO4_range", "NOx_range" , "Run_notes")%>% 
  rename(Nutr_Run_notes = Run_notes)
##Select unique rows because there are 4 of the same for each sample
nutr_ppr_sel_unique_2022 <- unique(nutr_ppr_sel_2022)

#Combine 2022 and 2023
# nutr_ppr_sel_unique <- bind_rows(nutr_ppr_sel_unique_2022, nutr_ppr_sel_unique_2023)
nutr_ppr_sel_unique <- nutr_ppr_sel_unique_2022


##Iron - need to collate 2022 data?
#2022
iron_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Iron/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "Summary_Data\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
# 3. Read and combine all CSVs
iron_data_2022 <- iron_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame

```

##Write out files
```{r write out combined data and metadata, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
colnames(joined_data)
final_data <- joined_data %>% 
  mutate(Project = "COMPASS: Synoptic", 
         Region = "CB") %>% 
  rename(H2S_mean_uM = H2S_mean, 
         H2S_sd_uM = H2S_sd, 
         FE_2_mean_uM = FE_2_mean, 
         FE_2_sd_uM = FE_2_sd, 
         FE_3_mean_uM = FE_3_mean, 
         FE_3_sd_uM = FE_3_sd) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Sample_ID, #MSM_202306_TR_PPR_3
    sep = "_",
    into = c("Site", "Date", "Zone", "Sampler_Type", "Replicate"),
    remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Month = as.numeric(substr(Date, 5, 6)), 
         Year = as.numeric(substr(Date, 1, 4))) 


##Pull in metadata dates
metadata_2022 <- read.csv("COMPASS_SynopticCB_PW_SampleLog_2022.csv")
metadata_2023 <- read.csv("COMPASS_SynopticCB_PW_SampleLog_2023.csv")
metadat <- bind_rows(metadata_2022, metadata_2023)

metadat <- metadat %>% 
  select("Year", "Month", "Day", "Site", "Transect.Location") %>% 
  rename(Zone = Transect.Location) %>% 
  mutate(Zone = case_when(
    `Zone` == "Upland" ~ "UP",
    `Zone` == "Transition" ~ "TR",
    `Zone` == "Wetland" ~ "WC",   
    `Zone` == "UPCON" ~ "UPCON",
    `Zone` == "Surface Water" ~ "SW",
    TRUE                 ~ `Zone`    # keep original value if no match
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Zone = case_when(
      Site == "SWH" & Zone == "UP" & Year == 2023 ~ "SWAMP",
      Site == "SWH" & Zone == "UPCON" & Year == 2023 ~ "UP",
      TRUE ~ `Zone`
    )) 

metadat <- unique(metadat)


final_data1 <- final_data %>% 
  left_join(metadat, by = c("Year", "Month", "Site", "Zone"))


####Convert Replicate to Depth 
PPR_Depths <- read_excel("MSM Peeper metadata 9_2_2022.xlsx")
colnames(PPR_Depths)
PPR_Depths1 <- PPR_Depths %>% 
  rename(Zone = Location, 
         Replicate = `Bottle # from top of well`, 
         Depth_cm = `Depth belowground_cm`) %>% 
  select(Site, Zone, Replicate, Depth_cm) %>% 
  mutate(Zone = case_when(
    Zone == "Upland" ~ "UP", 
    Zone == "Transition" ~ "TR", 
    Zone == "Wetland" ~ "WC", 
  )) %>% 
  mutate(Replicate = as.character(Replicate))


final_data2 <- final_data1 %>% 
  left_join(PPR_Depths1, by = c("Site", "Zone", "Replicate")) %>% 
  # mutate(Depth_cm = case_when(
  #   Replicate == 1 ~ 5, 
  #   Replicate == 2 ~ 15, 
  #   Replicate == 3 ~ 25, 
  #   Replicate == 4 ~ 35, 
  #   Replicate == 5 ~ 45, 
  #   Replicate == 6 ~ 55, 
  #   Replicate == 7 ~ 65, 
  #   Replicate == 8 ~ 75, 
  #   Replicate == 9 ~ 85, 
  #   Replicate == 10 ~ 95, 
  #   Replicate == 11 ~ 105, 
  #   Replicate == 12 ~ 115, 
  #   TRUE ~ NA)
  select(-Replicate) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, Sampler_Type, Depth_cm, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste0(Sample_ID, "cm"))


##Round data to sensitivity of the instrument 
colnames(final_data2)
##Based on raw data from the instrument: 
##SO4/Cl/Salinity - 4 decimals 
##H2S/Fe - 3 decimals
##Nutrients - 6 decimals 
final_data3 <- final_data2 %>% 
  mutate(SO4_ppm = round(as.numeric(SO4_ppm), digits = 4), 
         SO4_mM = round(as.numeric(SO4_mM), digits = 4), 
         Cl_ppm = round(as.numeric(Cl_ppm), digits = 4), 
         Cl_mM = round(as.numeric(Cl_mM), digits = 4), 
         Salinity = round(as.numeric(Salinity), digits = 4), 
         H2S_mean_uM = round(as.numeric(H2S_mean_uM), digits = 3), 
         H2S_sd_uM = round(as.numeric(H2S_sd_uM), digits = 3), 
         NH3_mgL = round(as.numeric(NH3_mgL), digits = 6), 
         NH3_uM = round(as.numeric(NH3_uM), digits = 6), 
         PO4_mgL = round(as.numeric(PO4_mgL), digits = 6), 
         PO4_uM = round(as.numeric(PO4_uM), digits = 6), 
         NOx_mgL = round(as.numeric(NOx_mgL), digits = 6), 
         NOx_uM = round(as.numeric(NOx_uM), digits = 6), 
         FE_2_mean_uM = round(as.numeric(FE_2_mean_uM), digits = 3), 
         FE_2_sd_uM = round(as.numeric(FE_2_sd_uM), digits = 3), 
         FE_3_mean_uM = round(as.numeric(FE_3_mean_uM), digits = 3), 
         FE_3_sd_uM = round(as.numeric(FE_3_sd_uM), digits = 3))

##Rename flag columns
final_data4 <- final_data3 %>%
  mutate(Sampler_Type = "Depth segmented peeper well") %>%   ##Rename sampler type 
  rename(Plot = Zone) %>% ##Rename zone to plot
  rename(Cl_flag = Cl_Conc_flag, 
         SO4_flag = SO4_Conc_flag, 
         H2S_flag = H2S_Conc_flag, 
         NH3_flag = NH3_range, 
         PO4_flag = PO4_range, 
         NOx_flag = NOx_range, 
         FE_2_flag = FE_2_flag, 
         FE_3_flag = FE_3_flag) %>% 
  select(c("Project", "Region", "Year", "Month", "Day", "Site", "Plot", "Depth_cm", "Sample_ID", "Sampler_Type", "SO4_ppm", "SO4_mM", "SO4_flag", "Cl_ppm", "Cl_mM", "Cl_flag", "Salinity", "H2S_mean_uM", "H2S_sd_uM", "H2S_flag", "NH3_mgL", "NH3_uM", "NH3_flag", "PO4_mgL", "PO4_uM", "PO4_flag", "NOx_mgL", "NOx_uM", "NOx_flag", "FE_2_mean_uM", "FE_2_sd_uM", "FE_2_flag", "FE_3_mean_uM", "FE_3_sd_uM", "FE_3_flag"))

# For the concentration flags - let's remove when it says "within range" and just make those NA so there is only a flag if it is above or below detection.
unique(final_data4$FE_2_flag)

final_data5 <- final_data4 %>% 
  mutate(Cl_flag = gsub("Within Range", "", Cl_flag), 
         SO4_flag = gsub("Within Range", "", SO4_flag), 
         H2S_flag = gsub("Within Range", "", H2S_flag), 
         NH3_flag = gsub("Within_Range", "", NH3_flag), 
         PO4_flag = gsub("Within_Range", "", PO4_flag), 
         NOx_flag = gsub("Within_Range", "", NOx_flag), 
         FE_2_flag = gsub("within range", "", FE_2_flag), 
         FE_3_flag = gsub("within range", "", FE_3_flag), 
         SO4_flag = replace_na(SO4_flag, ""), 
         Cl_flag = replace_na(Cl_flag, ""), 
         H2S_flag = replace_na(H2S_flag, ""), 
         NH3_flag = replace_na(NH3_flag, ""), 
         PO4_flag = replace_na(PO4_flag, ""), 
         NOx_flag = replace_na(NOx_flag, ""), 
         FE_2_flag = replace_na(FE_2_flag, ""), 
         FE_3_flag = replace_na(FE_3_flag, ""))

##Export final data
write.csv(final_data5, "COMPASS_SynopticCB_Peeper_Data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

##Visualize Data
